# Pre-canonical-token response validators

`zod.gen.ts` is the unmodified generated response-schema artifact from commit
`59facb6136c627b013beec410a2e4cd4f8188ec8`, generated by
`@hey-api/openapi-ts` 0.99.0.

It is intentionally frozen and test-only. The SDK compatibility test uses it
to prove that unchanged responses remain readable by the previous generated
client and to pin the two approved PAT/org token-creation incompatibilities.
